latest_validated_core_feature_head.message: Prove shadow site binding avoids redundant verified CDN fetch
latest_validated_core_feature_head.functional_increment: The single ordered Core v2 orchestrator now unifies all verified article outputs into one shadow article ledger and binds every current photo-verified story into a non-public site package. Exact provenance-verified Wikimedia derivatives are referenced for shadow package wiring without a redundant second binary fetch that can trigger CDN robot-policy rate limits. Canonical original URLs remain explicit, no photo/provenance/rights decision is changed, no public image delivery is inferred and publication_authority remains NONE.
